definitions.explanation: Demanding strict adherence to rules or standards, often describing a person's character, upbringing, or a system of discipline. Implies severity and unwillingness to tolerate lapses.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{厳格|げんかく}な{人|ひと}だった。
examples.english: My father was a strict person.

examples.japanese: {厳格|げんかく}な{教育|きょういく}を{受|う}けて{育|そだ}った。
examples.english: I was raised with a strict upbringing.

examples.japanese: この{学校|がっこう}は{校則|こうそく}が{厳格|げんかく}で、{服装|ふくそう}の{乱|みだ}れも{許|ゆる}されない。
examples.english: This school has strict rules, and even sloppy dress is not tolerated.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{厳格|げんかく}な{父親|ちちおや} (strict father)
・{厳格|げんかく}な{教育|きょういく} (strict education/upbringing)
・{厳格|げんかく}な{基準|きじゅん} (strict standards)
・{厳格|げんかく}に{適用|てきよう}する (apply rigorously)

Primarily describes people, institutions, or systems of authority. Distinguished from {厳密|げんみつ} (precise, exact) which focuses on accuracy rather than discipline.
